says: Deleting a CI file read only as text can omit its reader from changed-file selection.
proof: githubReads at vitest.config.ts:279-285 watches only current tracked .github paths. Installed Vitest 5.0.5 cli-api.De07GUeT.js:10055-10061 and :10135-10142 excludes nonexistent watched files. .github/ci/workflow-lint/scheduled.test.ts:15 dynamically reads workflow YAML and :180-181 checks scheduled.yaml; deleting that input leaves no current watch edge for its changed path. These source paths disagree without requiring a local run.
cost: A deletion can leave a reader untested by automatic related checks and the existing branch proof selector.
